verdict.rationale: ROCm docs confirm Linux x86-64 support and a headless-capable software stack (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, Llama.cpp) that can run without a GUI, which supports automation/CI-style ML workloads on the GPU. However, there is no explicit mention of CI pipelines, headless driver installation, Docker/container images, or automated build recipes. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, official container images, and headless-mode driver setup instructions.
